unit_payloads.loom-autoscaler-oldlab-staging.service:
[Unit]
Description=Loom oldlab external worker-pool autoscaler reconcile
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
TimeoutStartSec=180
WorkingDirectory=/opt/loom-staging-runner/candidates/78fbcbacb6dcdebb577692c1257f6e2226b73de6/repo
Environment=PYTHONPATH=/opt/loom-staging-runner/candidates/78fbcbacb6dcdebb577692c1257f6e2226b73de6/repo/src
Environment=PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
ExecStart=/opt/loom-staging-runner/candidates/78fbcbacb6dcdebb577692c1257f6e2226b73de6/venv/bin/python /opt/loom-staging-runner/candidates/78fbcbacb6dcdebb577692c1257f6e2226b73de6/repo/scripts/ops/worker_pool_autoscaler_external_once.py --environment staging --pool-name oldlab --namespace loom-staging --kubeconfig /var/lib/loom-staging-rollout/kubeconfig --db-local-host 127.0.0.1 --db-local-port 15448 --db-service service/loom-postgres-rw --db-remote-port 5432 --db-port-forward-ready-timeout-sec 10 --db-port-forward-stop-timeout-sec 5 --db-connect-timeout-sec 10 --freshness-sec 120
unit_payloads.loom-autoscaler-oldlab-staging.timer:
[Unit]
Description=Run Loom oldlab external autoscaler reconcile
# LoomDesiredState=active

[Timer]
OnBootSec=45
OnUnitActiveSec=30
AccuracySec=5
Unit=loom-autoscaler-oldlab-staging.service

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target
